core_memory.household_tasks: Trash—take out Wednesday morning. Vacuum living room. Mop the kitchen floor—sticky from last night's spill.
core_memory.car_maintenance: Car: Wash and vacuum on Sunday. Check tire pressure. Refill windshield wiper fluid.
core_memory.organizing_tasks: Organizing: Sort through closet—donate old clothes. Shred old mail. Restock pantry—running low on rice and cereal.
core_memory.diy_fixes: DIY Fixes: Tighten loose cabinet handle. Replace bathroom lightbulb. Patch up minor wall scuffs.
